verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents first-party M2M applications in AuthKit Connect that issue API access credentials so callers can access APIs programmatically (workos-docs-32). The docs contrast these with user-actor OAuth applications that use authorization_code (workos-docs-45, workos-docs-48), and AuthKit is described as a spec-compatible OAuth authorization server (workos-docs-27). Missing for 10: explicit naming of the client_credentials grant and its token-issuance mechanics, documented agent/backend-service usage examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
